output_list.reason: The 'distributeBTR' function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set balances of other users arbitrarily.
The 'transfer' function accepts an arbitrary user input '_amount' and can cause an integer overflow, causing the total supply of tokens to become stuck with the owner.
The 'transferFrom' function accepts an arbitrary user input '_amount' and can cause an integer overflow, causing the total supply of tokens to become stuck with the owner.
The 'approve' function has an integer overflow, allowing the owner to set the allowance of any user to a arbitrary large value, if exploited, it will disable the approval functionality.
